name: Baby Trend Sit N’ Stand® Double Stroller, Desert Blue
description: Experience the ultimate in versatility with the Sit N’ Stand Double Stroller from Baby Trend. It comfortably seats two children, and the rear seat can be removed for use of the included jump seat or standing platform. The two ratcheting canopies provide excellent sun protection for both of your passengers. The parent tray features 2 cup holders and a covered storage compartment for small incidentals and the roomy storage basket holds larger items. Both full-sized seats are equipped with reclining seatbacks, child trays with cup holders, and 5-point safety harnesses. The padded jump seat also includes a 3-point safety harness. The 8" EVA tires provide a smooth, comfortable ride and the lockable rear wheels provide stability on command. After your excursion, the Sit N’ Stand folds compact for convenient transport or storage.

description: Take both kids on any type of family outing with the BOB Gear Revolution(TM) Flex 3.0 Duallie Jogging Stroller. This travel stroller features a mountain bike-style suspension system and air-filled tires. The five-point harnesses on this compact double stroller have a no-rethread design to keep your child secure and allow easy height adjustments as your kids grow. The swivel-locking front wheel lets you maneuver this portable stroller easily through crowded streets and locks for stability when jogging, while the reflective accents keep you safe on all your journeys. Designed to transport two kids, this BOB double stroller has a 50-pound weight capacity per seat yet is slim enough to fit through standard doorways. The extra-large UPF 50+ canopies on this jogger stroller for toddlers and babies shield your little ones from the sun and include a magnetic “peek & chat” window. With a spacious cargo basket and 10 storage pockets, this BOB stroller offers plenty of room for all your gear.

description: For infants, the Cortina Together Double Stroller accepts any two Chicco infant car seats (sold separately), one in each seat. The front seat folds forward and the rear seat reclines to accept the car seat with integrated click-in attachment. No adapter needed! Two padded stroller seats with independent, adjustable and removable canopies accommodate older children. Both seats recline for comfort, with a multi-position full recline and cozy infant enclosure in the rear seat. The front seat includes interchangeable cup holders and a padded arm bar. All-wheel suspension and optional toe-tap swivels help maintain a smooth ride from surface to surface. The Cortina Together has a one-hand-activated, standing fold for easier maneuvering and storage. The parent tray includes two cup holders and storage for smaller items, and an oversized basket with rear zipper access provides ample space for larger items. A padded 3-position handle comfortably accommodates mom or dad, and toe-tap brakes keep the stroller in place when parked.
